proposal.summary: An SQL injection vulnerability exists in Moodle versions 3.11 through 3.11.4 in the h5p activity web service that fetches user attempt data.
proposal.cwe_quote: An SQL injection risk was identified in the h5p activity web service responsible for fetching user attempt data.
